title: Depreciation types
html:
The type of depreciation can generally be:

  • Straight-line: distributes the value of the asset evenly over the useful life — the same amount of depreciation in every period

  • Straight-line with period control: different multipliers can be defined for different periods

  • Immediate write-off: the method applied to low-value assets, with which the full value of the asset can be accounted for as depreciation in the year of acquisition

In the input field, enter the code and the rate of the depreciation and select its type. This code can be entered at the depreciation of the given asset.
